P3_inherited_11.reading: An ordered summary: weaving in daytime; unraveling by torchlight; both concern the same work patient.
P3_inherited_11.binding: A3=[WEAVE,UNRAVEL]. First activity has schedule DAY in E; second has illumination TORCHES. Patient slot phi is introduced but unresolved until the first literal qokedy in N4. Neither activity executes.

P3_inherited_11.raw: sar shedaiin ockhey sain ched shedy
P3_inherited_11.reading: The public participants believe the apparent progress visible by day.
P3_inherited_11.binding: BELIEVE(O,APPEARANCE(VISIBLE_IN(PROGRESS(phi),DAY))) in E. O is exactly the later wooers. This is a belief/observation claim, not FINISHED(C).

P3_inherited_11.reading: They judge by daytime observation, without knowing that the second activity occurs.
P3_inherited_11.binding: JUDGE_BY(O,DAY,E); NOT_KNOW(O,OCCURS(SECOND(A3),phi,E),E). SECOND here is a counted part of new lchedy, not a changed meaning of old saiin.

P3_inherited_11.reading: Concerning unraveling the cloth by torchlight.
P3_inherited_11.binding: CONCERNING(ILLUMINATED(UNRAVEL(C),TORCHES)). First qokedy binds phi=C. This overt topic construction is nominal: it is neither a newly executed unravelling nor a replacement of the later concealed-action assertion.

P3_inherited_11.reading: In contrast, the woman applies the first activity to the cloth.
P3_inherited_11.binding: IN_CONTRAST(APPLY(C,W,FIRST(A3))). FIRST(A3) returns exactly WEAVE. W is supplied before APPLY is asserted; V3=habitual WEAVE(W,C) in E, inheriting the declared DAY schedule. No action is attached to a generic actor label.

P3_inherited_11.reading: Concerning the cloth, it is not finished in that earlier period.
P3_inherited_11.binding: CONCERNING(C); holds(E,NOT(FINISHED(C))). FINISHED retains its old patient C and predicate status.

P3_inherited_11.raw: sol chedy lkedy qokchedy qokedy chckhdy sar
P3_inherited_11.reading: In contrast, completion is required in a request concerning that cloth by the public participants.
P3_inherited_11.binding: REQUEST(O,REQUIRED(FINISHED(C)),patient=C). The predicate is quoted as required, not asserted true in E. This is a new interpretation of the public demand, not a claim that marriage occurs.

P3_inherited_11.reading: Later, under compulsion, she weaves, attaining completion.
P3_inherited_11.binding: Z3=actual WEAVE(W,C), COMPELLED, later than E, capped by ATTAINS_STATE(FINISHED(C)). The omitted worker and object retain W and C. The new paragraph does not itself insert discovery; the separate unchanged parent later supplies Z4 after its discovery.

P3_inherited_11.reading: Contrast the earlier work period: its state was unfinished.
P3_inherited_11.binding: COMPARE(holds(E,NOT(FINISHED(C))),outcome(Z3)). otedy has exactly its N6 denotation and otaiin exactly its N11 period reference.

P3_inherited_11.reading: Recall the visible daytime progress on the cloth: those occurrences precede the onset when the cloth is finished.
P3_inherited_11.binding: G=VISIBLE_PROGRESS_OCCURRENCES(C,DAY,E); PRECEDES(G,ONSET(WHEN(FINISHED(C)))). The completion onset is outcome(Z3), not an added completion event. WHEN performs only B3 lifting; FINISHED remains the original predicate.

P3_inherited_11.raw: soiiin checthy chety otaiin olsaly shedy
P3_inherited_11.reading: Those progress occurrences recur within the earlier work period, in each daytime.
P3_inherited_11.binding: RECURRENT(REF(G),WITHIN(E),EACH(DAY-instance in E)). G remains N10's occurrence class. No duration, number of cycles, equal work/undoing quantity or marriage is supplied.

P4_inherited_8.reading: Weaving, as opposed to unweaving, the cloth.
P4_inherited_8.binding: A=[WEAVE,UNRAVEL], both with patient C. Action names only; zero executed actions.

P4_inherited_8.reading: Completion of the cloth is a prerequisite for marriage.
P4_inherited_8.binding: P=prerequisite(FINISHED(C),MARRIAGE(W)); neither completion nor marriage is asserted here.

P4_inherited_8.reading: In secret, the woman unravels the cloth.
P4_inherited_8.binding: U=habitual UNRAVEL(W,C), concealed from public participants O. qoky introduces W; otchey introduces concealed status. No exact nightly quantity.

P4_inherited_8.reading: By day she publicly pledges that prerequisite.
P4_inherited_8.binding: PLEDGE(W,O,P,DAY). The pledge takes C2, the most recent proposition of prerequisite type; C3 is an action, not an eligible proposition.

P4_inherited_8.reading: Until the cloth is finished, she weaves it row by row.
P4_inherited_8.binding: V=habitual WEAVE(W,C), prospectively bounded by FINISHED(C), with ROW ROW interpreted distributively. The endpoint is not asserted as reached by this clause.

P4_inherited_8.reading: The first and second activities on that cloth have daytime and nighttime, respectively.
P4_inherited_8.binding: C1 first=WEAVE binds C5 V to DAY; C1 second=UNRAVEL binds C3 U to NIGHT. qokedy requires the same C. No new action or event is introduced.

P4_inherited_8.reading: A handmaid informs the wooers; they discover the concealed action at night.
P4_inherited_8.binding: INFORM(H,O,U); DISCOVER(O,U,NIGHT). The written qody is the report recipient and following discovery subject. The common concealed-action object is U. Discovery does not manufacture a further unweaving event.

P4_inherited_8.reading: Then, under compulsion, the woman weaves the cloth to completion.
P4_inherited_8.binding: After C7 discovery: actual WEAVE(W,C) under compulsion, capped by SAII at FINISHED(C). Neither a marriage nor an additional unweaving is asserted.

state_inheritance.completion: FINISHED(C) through inherited compelled action Z
state_inheritance.alternative: RECAP_E, one explicit global retrospective operator
state_inheritance.fresh_stock_rival: FRESH_STOCK requires a new denotation binding and is therefore unresolved/rejected by this account

productions.rule: Build a typed assertion/report from the supplied operator and proposition. Reported, recorded, public, concerning and exception operators modify the same proposition type; they do not introduce hidden events.
lchedy is KNOWS(subject,OCCURS(SECOND(A))); shey is NOT_KNOWS(subject,OCCURS(SECOND(A)),time=E). Both shey cases use this same form and the same retrospective time argument E.
Compose a phase-qualified inherited activity/state relation. s links to inherited discovery; chedy always evaluates FINISHED(C); no fresh cloth, worker or completion event is introduced.
Coordinate, quantify or repeat typed participants and propositions while preserving their arguments. It cannot erase a proposition or create a paragraph-specific meaning.

debt: The 38 P5 values are fitted provisional guesses; no independent evidence selects them.
The uniform AFTER_COMPLETION scope is a declared choice. RECAP_E remains a live rival and is not eliminated by this account.
The IT reader is retained as a complete 92-group comparison unit but receives no additional semantic assignments or cap increase.
The diplomatic ZL exceptions remain unresolved and no RF complete reader is available.

nondefault_bindings.name: SAME_CLOTH
nondefault_bindings.rule: P5 chedy and all inherited FINISHED references denote the inherited cloth C.

nondefault_bindings.name: SAME_WORKER
nondefault_bindings.rule: No P5 token introduces a second worker; inherited W remains the only worker argument where required.

nondefault_bindings.name: SAME_PUBLIC_GROUP
nondefault_bindings.rule: sar and inherited qody denote the same public participants O.

nondefault_bindings.name: INHERITED_DISCOVERY
nondefault_bindings.rule: P5 s THEN_AFTER takes the inherited DISCOVERED(O,U) edge; it does not create a second discovery.

nondefault_bindings.name: INHERITED_COMPLETION
nondefault_bindings.rule: P5 chedy takes the inherited FINISHED(C) state; it does not execute a new finishing event.

nondefault_bindings.name: GLOBAL_SCOPE
nondefault_bindings.rule: One choice scopes the connected account: AFTER_COMPLETION or RECAP_E; no line-level phase switching.

scope_contract.rule: V2 selects one uniform AFTER_COMPLETION context for the P5 assertion. Both shey clauses report NOT_KNOWS(..., time=E), the inherited earlier period, so present lchedy knowledge and earlier shey ignorance are not silently conflated. RECAP_E remains the explicit whole-account rival, not a line-level repair.

semantic_state.before_discovery: In inherited E, O sees apparent daytime progress and lacks knowledge of the second activity; completion is required but not yet asserted.
semantic_state.after_completion: Inherited compelled action Z gives FINISHED(C); P5 records the now-public knowledge of the second activity while preserving two retrospective NOT_KNOWS-at-E statements.
semantic_state.object_lineage: All P5 activity and state formulas use inherited C,W,O,U,A; no fresh stock is introduced.
